## Technical Corrections to This Historical Draft

This source is retained for audit history and is excluded from the production reading path. The corrections below govern its interpretation; the original wording is preserved separately.

The displayed quadratic remainder requires more than differentiability: for example, $f$ may be $C^2$ with a bounded Hessian on the relevant neighborhood. Then $A=Df(x)$ and the remainder is bounded in a specified norm by a constant times $\|\delta x\|^2$. Under only differentiability the general remainder is $o(\|\delta x\|)$.

For state/input perturbations, expand jointly and retain mixed derivatives. A local vector-field bound is not yet a trajectory-error bound; the remainder must be propagated through the variational dynamics over an interval on which the solutions exist. See [canonical residuals](../../../tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-4-residuals-curvature.html).

Current reading path: [Canonical Series Article](/articles/tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-4-residuals-curvature.html).

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true" title="Historical Draft: Superseded Wording"}

## Taylor Expansion

$$
f(x + \delta x) = f(x) + A\delta x + O(\|\delta x\|^2)
$$

## Exactness in the Limit

As $\delta x \to 0$, higher-order terms vanish.

:::
